from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform full rows and columns are compartment dividers.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_ranges=[]
    start=0
    for r in sep_rows:
        if start < r: row_ranges.append((start,r))
        start=r+1
    if start<h: row_ranges.append((start,h))
    col_ranges=[]
    start=0
    for c in sep_cols:
        if start<c: col_ranges.append((start,c))
        start=c+1
    if start<w: col_ranges.append((start,w))
    # Ignore divider colors and the dominant background; count the isolated marks.
    divider_values={grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in divider_values)
    background=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mark_values=set(counts)-{background}
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in row_ranges:
        line=[]
        for c0,c1 in col_ranges:
            n=sum(grid[r][c] in mark_values for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            line.append(1 if n%2==0 else 7)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
